_note: Hand-written offline playbooks. SENTINEL only recommends; every action is analyst-approved and nothing is executed automatically.

playbooks.title: Investigate suspected credential compromise
steps: Contact the account owner out-of-band and confirm whether they initiated the session
Review all logons for the account from the same source IP or device in the last 7 days
Check for MFA prompts, VPN sessions and mailbox rule changes for the account

playbooks.title: Reset credentials and revoke active sessions
steps: Reset the account password (and krbtgt-dependent tickets if a privileged account is affected)
Revoke active sessions and refresh tokens
Require re-enrolment of MFA if the factor may be compromised

playbooks.title: Review account lockout and failed-logon source
steps: Identify the source host/IP of the failed logons and its owner
Check whether the account was locked out and whether a success followed
Look for the same source targeting other accounts

playbooks.title: Investigate password spraying across accounts
steps: List every account targeted by the source and check each for a subsequent successful logon
Force password resets for targeted accounts that logged on successfully afterwards
Review password policy and lockout thresholds

playbooks.title: Block or monitor the source address
steps: Confirm the source address is not a legitimate shared gateway or NAT address
Request a firewall/VPN block or heightened monitoring for the address (analyst approval required)

playbooks.title: Validate privileged group change against approval records
steps: Look up a change ticket or approval for the membership change
Confirm the actor's role and whether they are permitted to change this group
Check what the added account did after the change

playbooks.title: Revoke unauthorised privileged membership
steps: If no approval exists, remove the account from the privileged group (analyst approval required)
Review other privileged groups for unexpected members
Audit actions performed with the elevated rights

playbooks.title: Investigate suspicious process execution
steps: Decode and review the full command line and parent process chain
Check the host for files written or network connections made by the process
Search other hosts for the same command line or hash

playbooks.title: Preserve endpoint evidence
steps: Collect volatile data (running processes, network connections, memory image) before reboot
Export available event logs and EDR telemetry from the host
Record hashes of collected artefacts for chain of custody

playbooks.title: Investigate audit-log clearing
steps: Recover the cleared events from a log forwarder or SIEM copy
Identify the account and process that cleared the log
Treat activity on the host before the clearing as potentially hidden and widen the time range

playbooks.title: Isolate the affected host
steps: Request network isolation of the host through EDR or switch port (analyst approval required)
Keep the host powered on to preserve memory evidence

playbooks.title: Escalate to the incident response lead
steps: Open an incident ticket with this report attached
Notify the incident response lead and the system owner
Agree containment actions before making changes

playbooks.title: Review privileged group discovery
steps: Identify who ran the enumeration command and from which session.
Check whether the account normally administers groups (helpdesk/IT) or whether this is new behaviour.
Look for follow-on activity by the same account: group membership changes, logons to domain controllers, credential access.
If unexplained, monitor the account closely and review its recent privilege changes.
